GATE 4N-I26B, closing I26B-02. The INDEPENDENT authority for external-evidence expectations. Gate 4N-I25's security lane fabricated a PRODUCTION_CERTIFIED artifact and the shipping verify CLI PERMITTED it, because the 'expected' external values came from a file the CALLER supplied: invent a digest, echo the same digest into --external-binding, and the comparison agrees with itself. Two caller-supplied documents cross-checking each other is not verification.

The repository cannot re-derive Tier-2 evidence — it is protected and lives outside the tree — so it authenticates instead: the DIGEST of the authorized external-authorization document is pinned HERE, in a tracked file. Forging one now requires editing tracked repository content, which moves the index tree, which the repository binding already covers. The caller supplies the document; the repository decides which document counts.

field_semantics.authorization_version: schema version of the authorization document
field_semantics.protected_tier: the tier this authorization speaks for; only TIER_2_PROTECTED may certify production
field_semantics.approved_anchor_sha256: digest of the identity anchor the artifact must name
field_semantics.approved_inventory_sha256: digest of the external inventory the artifact must name
field_semantics.approved_evidence_classification: the provenance label the evidence must carry
field_semantics.non_synthetic_required: whether synthetic evidence is refused outright
field_semantics.eligibility_lineage_sha256: digest binding the eligibility record the certification descends from
field_semantics.required_production_checks: check ids that must all be present AND satisfied
field_semantics.valid_until_utc: when it lapses; a lapsed authorization certifies nothing
field_semantics.authorized_candidate_scope: the candidate id this authorization covers

pin_note: TIER_2_PROTECTED has NO pin here on purpose. A real production authorization is supplied under separate protected authority and its digest is installed at that time. An absent pin means the verifier REFUSES, which is the correct behaviour for a repository that has never been shown the real document.
